The main social room ('společenská místnost', photos 021-023) has traditional timber log walls, tiled floors, red and black leather sofas around a coffee table, a wood-burning stove, wall-mounted TV, table football, and electronic darts; however, table seating in this room is limited to one octagonal wooden table seating 6 (photos 021, 023) and one rectangular wooden dining table with 6 chairs (photo 022), providing only ~12 table work spots. A completely separate dining room ('jídelna', photos 024-025) is long, narrow, and utilitarian with exposed overhead heating pipes, containing one long modular wooden table paired with ~14 chairs and a perimeter corner bench, plus a breakfast sideboard. There is no single communal hall where 25-30 people can gather together at tables for workshops or concurrent laptop work. A dedicated bar area (photos 026-028) features a brick counter with 4 bar stools, a single-tap draft beer cooler, a Krups bean-to-cup coffee machine, and a glass-front beverage fridge. Kitchen facilities (photos 030-033) are genuinely semi-commercial: commercial gastro dishwasher (photo 031), combi-steamer/convection oven (photo 030), professional rotary meat/bread slicer, expansive stainless steel island and work prep tables, induction hob, double stainless sink, and multiple refrigerators. Outdoors (photos 005, 040-041), there is a covered barbecue patio with picnic tables and a dedicated rotisserie spit grill for roasting whole meats. Wellness is very modest and mislabeled: photo 034 shows a small, older 3-4 person pine Finnish sauna, while the advertised 'Indoor Heated Pool' is factually incorrect as photo 037 clearly depicts an unheated, seasonal above-ground circular garden pool on the lawn; no hot tub is present. Bedrooms (photos 012-017) are basic and dated with pine furniture; 4 of the 7 rooms include bunk beds (e.g. photo 017), with occupancy reaching 5 and 6 beds per room. Positively, all 7 bedrooms feature private en-suite tiled bathrooms (shower + WC, photos 018-020).
